priest_style: Read aloud in Polish, as a warm, charismatic older Polish Catholic priest speaking to his parish in a small church. Natural, lively pace, no long pauses.
crowd_style: Read aloud in Polish, as one older member of a Polish church congregation answering the priest together with everyone, natural and sincere.

p_intro: slowly and solemnly, like a warm old Polish priest beginning Mass
W imię Ojca i Syna, i Ducha Świętego.
p_panzwami: warmly, like a kind old Polish priest greeting his parish
p_hype: playfully with a smile, then with rising energy at the end, like a charismatic old Polish priest
Kochani! Mówią, że msza jest nudna. To dzisiaj sprawdzimy. Niech ten kościół zaświeci!
p_gloria: joyfully and loudly, almost shouting with happiness, like an excited old Polish priest
Chwała na wysokości Bogu! Wszyscy razem!
p_homily: calmly and warmly, intimately, with a gentle smile, like a wise old Polish priest

Spójrzcie na tę ścianę. Każde okienko osobno to tylko kawałek szkła. Ale kiedy wpada przez nie słońce, cała ściana świeci. Z nami jest tak samo. Każdy z was jest takim okienkiem. A Bóg jest światłem. Wystarczy się otworzyć.
p_amenq: playfully, as a question to the crowd, like a cheerful old Polish priest
p_amenq2: playfully and louder, teasing the crowd, like a cheerful old Polish priest
p_pokoj: joyfully and warmly, like a happy old Polish priest
p_cisza: very quietly and reverently, almost whispering, slowly, like an old Polish priest
p_wstancie: softly and moved at first, then rising to a strong joyful call, like an old Polish priest
On jest z nami. Wstańcie i chwalcie Pana!
p_idzcie: strongly and festively, like a joyful old Polish priest
p_koniec: laughing, delighted, like a warm old Polish priest
No i kto powiedział, że msza jest nudna?
p_alleluja: shouting with joy, like an old Polish priest
p_glosniej: loudly, encouraging the crowd, like an old Polish priest
p_pieknie: delighted, like an old Polish priest
p_brawo: enthusiastically, like an old Polish priest
p_jeszcze: energetically, like an old Polish priest
p_obudzcie: humorously and a bit loud, teasing, like an old Polish priest
p_halo: humorously, surprised, like an old Polish priest
